answer: With a Design mockup approved in peer review backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The design treats each contribution as a trellis: small alone, decisive in aggregate. A harbor alone is noise; a vault of accepted work is a pattern the network can trust.
